_about: The eval set for rung 2 (npm run eval). Each item is one message, or an archive thread replayed up to a message, and the answers we accept for the LAST step. Archive items: urgency is the archive's label, except where the first message alone cannot know it (case-04); next_step is what the manager did first (hand labels in ../dwelly-history-eda/annotations.json), plus any step a good manager could defend. Variants are hand-written tone flips of archive cases: the tone must not move the urgency. An item whose lowest accepted urgency is high or emergency is critical: rating it lower is a hard fail.

items.why: water through a ceiling light: water + electrics
a steady drip: a fault that gets worse
cosmetic; photos first to rule out structure
'no rush' leak; the manager first said medium (high came with messages[6])
gas: the emergency line, no work order
no heating or hot water in freezing weather
dead fan in a windowless bathroom
flicker + trips + hot smell: fire risk, even with the circuit off
one dead socket; electrical is not high by itself
slow drain with standing water
neighbour noise: not a repair, however upset the tenant is
ground-floor window will not lock: home not secure
recurring mould: rule out a leak before calling it condensation
radiator cold at the top: bleed it
supplied washing machine leaks: the landlord's to fix
the turning point: water has reached the flat below
